_about: Host ids for the test module only (ROADMAP B714), in a block of its own far from the test plug-in's ledger (tools/engine-preview/host_ids.lock.json), so a test build never takes an id the product's ledger could hand out. Read only by the test configuration and tools/rack_check.py. tools/host_id_ledger_check.py holds it append-only too.
